env.scratch: SCR = a fresh empty dir (this run: the session scratchpad .../scratchpad/p4ns); mkdir -p $SCR/service $SCR/udG
env.tree: git archive origin/main (0a03e29) | tar -x -C $SCR/snap; ln -s <repo>/node_modules $SCR/snap/node_modules; no .env in $SCR/snap; electron.vite.config.ts renderer section gets cacheDir: resolve(__dirname, '.vite-cache') and server: { port: 5197, strictPort: true } (a private Vite cache: no other session's edit can reload this app)
env.service: cd $SCR/snap && env -u SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY -u SERVICE_CHAIN_ID -u SERVICE_CHAIN_RPC_URL -u SERVICE_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8796 --data $SCR/service   (no .env in the snapshot, so Bun loads none)
env.app: cd $SCR/snap && env -u UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_RPC_URL -u UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS -u UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_CHAIN_ID OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_URL= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_ACCOUNTS= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_FROM_BLOCK= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_HOOK= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_PARENT= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_REGISTRY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_ROUTER= UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/udG bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9344   (ps eww on Electron main: no UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_* and no SERVICE_*; the listed keys present and empty)
env.driver: from the repo root: CDP_PORT=9344 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p4-chain/<part>.json)"
env.stop: kill $(lsof -tiTCP:8796 -sTCP:LISTEN)   (SIGTERM; the service logs 'stopped (SIGTERM), snapshots written'; curl /v1/health then exits 7)
env.close: bun close-app.ts with CDP_PORT=9344 (docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p4-no-servers/close-app.ts.txt): CDP Browser.close on the browser target

'').includes('World services')); if (!ta) return 'no field'; ta.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); ta.focus(); return ta === document.activeElement })()

(() => { const field = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find(t => t.value.includes('ws://127.0.0.1:8796')); let box = field; while (box && ![...box.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test')) box = box.parentElement; const btn = [...box.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test'); btn.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); btn.click(); return 'clicked the Shared worlds Test' })()
